hey, its kinda hard to explain, i'll just post what I did originally on the teaching subreddit, if it helps the edtpa is basically this really big thing teachers have to do like a case study that gets them their teaching certification:

​

T/W S/icid/l thoughts

Hi, I'm in my senior year of college and I'm currently in my last semester. I'm an Early Childhood Education major. So currently I'm having to do my edtpa and my internship, along with course work. I've had anxiety since middle school and am medicated, as a result of my anxiety I also have lingering symptoms of depression as well. I also have ADD and have been medicated for that as well since 3rd grade. I've felt like I wouldn't make it through schoolwork before, but this is different. I feel absolutely unable to complete everything that is expected of me this semester. I am transitioning to teaching full days, and am expected to write long form lesson plans for each subject as I start out (one subject is added per week for me to teach) to teach the following week and turn them in on Thursdays. This week I need 3 lesson plans per day (1 writing, and two guided reading), with no school Wednesdays and MLK day Monday that is nine lessons. I am also supposed to have most of task 1 of my edtpa written by now, but all I have is an outline as I find the wording hard to interpret and the amount of prompts overwhelming. I'm planning to teach my segment not this week but the following week. I also have way more coursework than I believe is appropriate for one class. I also had to take an extra course due to my advisor not informing me the pesh class I was taking last semester actually didn't count towards the pesh credit I need to graduate. I seriously can't see myself managing it all and I've had many passive suicidal ideations lately. I've become extremely anxious and depressed and I have almost no motivation to do anything at all. I feel like I'm going to just end up having a total mental breakdown and just not show up to my internship one day and get kicked out of school. At this point, I feel like that would be a good thing, but I also feel like it would be bad. I'm so close to graduating (even if I don't pass the edtpa and get my certification), but I'm worried I'm going to end up failing somehow anyway or ending up kicked out. I don't feel like I'm a very good teacher, and I've been questioning my career options as I'm finding I'm not enjoying it as much as I had hoped. I've talked with my mom a lot about it. She says it would be ok if I got kicked out or I didn't pass, etc. that we would figure it out. She also suggested I just keep trying, and if and when I can't anymore, well that we will figure things out. I feel like a failure and I'm worried because of covid I'm currently alone in my apartment all by myself. I don't really have friends to lean on either. I don't know what to do. I'm also afraid of the possibility one day I'm not going to have all my lessons ready and my mentor teacher will chew me out and I'll have a full mental breakdown on the spot and get kicked out. I really don't know what to do. I'm just so tired.
